root_cause.summary: The cart container exited with exit_code 137 (SIGKILL). No OOM flag on the container itself, but the host is under high memory pressure (multiple services >90% memory, astronomy-db OOM flag true). The host likely killed the cart process, causing downstream checkout and frontend errors.
alternatives: astronomy-db OOM could be a co‑occurring issue.
